# Weekly Meal Plan Skill

Tell this skill how many dinners you want, how many people are eating, and any allergies, and it builds a simple day-by-day plan with one easy recipe per day, sensible leftover reuse, and a grocery list grouped by aisle that includes only what you do not already have.

You say how many dinners you want, the default is 5, never 7 unless you ask for 7, and you get one grocery list grouped by aisle with only what you are missing. No shop price, no shop name, no brand and no nutrition number is invented.
